data.description:
CREATE SECURITY.md DOCUMENTATION

FILE: SECURITY.md (new file in repo root)
SECTIONS: Security Policy, Supported Versions, Platform Support, Security Design

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- SECURITY.md exists in repo root
- Covers: zero deps, JSON-first, atomic writes, fcntl locking
- README.md links to SECURITY.md

GUARDRAILS - DO NOT:
- Include specific vulnerability details
- Make promises about response times
- Modify CLAUDE.md

VERIFY: test -f SECURITY.md && grep -q "Security Policy" SECURITY.md

properties.retrospective: Created 142-line SECURITY.md with all required sections.
